picks.title: Hermes agent maker Nous Research in talks for new funding at $1.5B valuation
picks.why_it_matters: A $1.5B valuation for an AI agent infrastructure company signals continued strong investor appetite for agentic AI tooling, and the involvement of Robot Ventures and USV validates the category for seed-stage bets in adjacent spaces.

picks.title: Japan develops a method to recover up to 90% of lithium from used EV batteries
picks.why_it_matters: A breakthrough in battery recycling efficiency could unlock new startup opportunities in circular economy and battery materials, especially as EV adoption scales and lithium supply constraints persist.

picks.title: Apple's new SpeechAnalyzer API, benchmarked against Whisper and its predecessor
picks.why_it_matters: Apple shipping competitive on-device speech recognition changes the build-vs-buy calculus for voice AI startups and signals growing platform-level commoditization of transcription—founders should consider differentiation beyond core ASR.
